subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Students learned that accessibility is not only about meeting minimum rules.”?
options: People may laugh for a moment and then move on.
People had seen it as a problem to move.
It is about whether people can actually move with safety and dignity.
Another showed a product that solved a problem few people actually had.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「People may laugh for a moment and then move on.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「People had seen it as a problem to move.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Students learned that accessibility is not only about meeting minimum rules. It is about whether people can actually move with safety and…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Students learned that accessibility is not only about meeting minimum rules. It is about whether people can actually move with safety and dignity.」，答案為「It is about whether people can actually move with safety and dignity.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「It is about whether people can actually move with safety and dignity.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
